description: This file defines the DataObjects_Channel class, representing the 'channel' table in the database for the Revive Adserver project. It includes properties mapping to database columns, methods for deletion, duplication, and audit trail management, and handles relationships with ACLs and banners.

classes.name: DataObjects_Channel
classes.description: Represents a channel entity in the database, with properties for channel attributes, methods for managing related ACLs and banners, duplication, deletion, and audit trail functionalities.

methods.name: staticGet
methods.description: Static method to retrieve a DataObjects_Channel instance by key.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes the channel and updates related ACLs and banners accordingly.

methods.name: duplicate
methods.description: Duplicates the channel record and its ACLs, assigning a new channel ID.

methods.name: _auditEnabled
methods.description: Returns true, indicating auditing is enabled for this object.

methods.name: _getContextId
methods.description: Returns the channel ID for context identification.

methods.name: _getContext
methods.description: Returns the string 'Channel' as the context name.

methods.name: getOwningAccountIds
methods.description: Returns account IDs owning this channel, based on affiliate or agency relationships.

methods.name: _buildAuditArray
methods.description: Builds an array of audit trail data specific to this channel.
